messages:
jamie-ops: FYI CI is red on main, looks like an immediate spike in failures on the linux-gpu job — several e2e-image-upload tests failing. Anyone know who rolled libtrace last night? :eyes:
priya-eng: I triggered a dep bump PR yesterday (libtrace -> 1.4.2) but it passed my local runs. Link: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/2345
matt-infra: I saw a burst of failures in nightly ~02:30 UTC. Could be a flaky interaction with gpu runners. Opening a bisect request now.
ci-bot: [status] linux-gpu #3248 failed: e2e-image-upload::upload_large_file (16/20) — logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/3248/log
oncall-bot: paging oncall: @priya-eng @matt-infra — CI red on main.
priya-eng: thanks — i'm re-running the failed job now to confirm flakiness. If it repros reliably we should find last-green and bisect.
jamie-ops: re-run not stable, 2/3 reruns passed, 1 repro. I'm leaning toward a regression but intermittent. Matt, can you find last green for linux-gpu?
matt-infra: checking git build history. Last green on linux-gpu was build 3236, which corresponds to commit `984f2a7` (2026-03-15). The dep bump MR merged at `a1b3cde` after that. Suggest `git bisect` between `984f2a7`..`a1b3cde` on CI run.
priya-eng: if it's the dep bump MR, i can revert quickly. But want to be sure. Can we run a targeted bisect job?
jamie-ops: yes — create a temporary branch and run the linux-gpu e2e suite across the range. Matt, can you spin a bisect job using the bisect harness? Command i usually use:
```
git bisect start
git bisect bad a1b3cde
git bisect good 984f2a7
# then run the e2e image-upload test on each bisect step
```
I can watch results.
matt-infra: started bisect run: https://ci.example.com/bisect/789 — first few steps queued.
ci-bot: [bisect] step 3/12: commit `b2d9ff1` — test failed (e2e-image-upload::upload_large_file).
priya-eng: that commit is the libtrace bump revert candidate? Let me check the diff.
jamie-ops: if bisect pins to a commit that touches the libtrace ABI, we should consider an emergency revert. Priya, can you prepare a revert PR but don't merge until we confirm final commit from bisect.
priya-eng: on it — drafting revert PR: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/2350 (WIP)
matt-infra: bisect progressed: step 7/12 landed on commit `c3e5aa9` which also fails. Step 10/12 is green. Narrowing.
ci-bot: [bisect] final result: first bad commit `b2d9ff1` — touches vendor/libtrace and a small change to upload client timeout. Details: https://ci.example.com/bisect/789/result
jamie-ops: good work. `b2d9ff1` is in the dep bump MR chain. Priya, can you finalize the revert and mark it urgent? We should roll it to prod if it fixes.
priya-eng: revert PR updated and running presubmit. If presubmit passes i'll merge and trigger a candidate rollback on staging. cc @matt-infra for rollout plan.
matt-infra: plan: merge revert -> run linux-gpu e2e on staging -> if green, roll to main with a short maintenance window. I'll coordinate.
oncall-bot: action items: revert PR https://git.example.com/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/2350, run staging e2e, monitor for regressions.
jamie-ops: thanks team. If revert doesn't fix, we'll reopen bisect for non-dep causes. For now priority P0 until staging is green. :hammer:
